sql: WITH x AS (SELECT hardware_model, firmware_version, avg(lte_loss_pct) AS a FROM marts.fct_device_daily WHERE event_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-01-07' AND firmware_version IN ('1.0.0','1.1.0') AND lte_loss_pct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1,2) SELECT hardware_model, round(max(CASE WHEN firmware_version='1.0.0' THEN a END),2) AS avg_lte_loss_1_0_0, round(max(CASE WHEN firmware_version='1.1.0' THEN a END),2) AS avg_lte_loss_1_1_0, round(max(CASE WHEN firmware_version='1.1.0' THEN a END) - max(CASE WHEN firmware_version='1.0.0' THEN a END),2) AS increase_pp FROM x GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY increase_pp DESC

WITH x AS (SELECT hardware_model, firmware_version, avg(lte_loss_pct) AS a FROM marts.fct_device_daily WHERE event_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-01-07' AND firmware_version IN ('1.0.0','1.1.0') AND lte_loss_pct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1,2) SELECT hardware_model, round(max(CASE WHEN firmware_version='1.0.0' THEN a END),2) AS avg_lte_loss_1_0_0, round(max(CASE WHEN firmware_version='1.1.0' THEN a END),2) AS avg_lte_loss_1_1_0, round(max(CASE WHEN firmware_version='1.1.0' THEN a END) - max(CASE WHEN firmware_version='1.0.0' THEN a END),2) AS increase_pp FROM x GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY increase_pp DESC
